1006619884954976258.a: One thing concerns me gravely about @Twitter et al takedowns. They just disappear as if they never happened. It seems to me that people's bad words should not be hidden but preserved. Over time, the evildoers will look like saints with all their bad words cleansed from history.

1006620560984563712.a: Perhaps a better option would be to replace those posts with a TOS violation warning that allows one to click-through and read the original message. (For actual human beings. I am not sure we need to keep a billion bot tweets unless they are somehow relevant to a human's post.)
